summary.text: Matt Day, a Republican business owner from Douglas, Georgia, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Georgia's 2nd Congressional District to incumbent Sanford Bishop.

His campaign website lists experience in the glazing and construction industries and in software development, and the Atlanta Journal-Constitution reports that he calls himself a commonsense conservative.

paragraphs.text: Day is from Douglas, Georgia, and is described by the Atlanta Journal-Constitution as a business owner.
His campaign website lists glazing, construction and software development as the experience he brings to the race.
He was unopposed in the May 19, 2026 Republican primary, according to Ballotpedia, and faced incumbent Democrat Sanford Bishop Jr. in the November general election.
He received 39.2% of the vote to Sanford Bishop's 60.8%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
